item: M112 — the trading window is a hard block, not a penalty
issue: No trading-window guardrail although performance.js already computed by_session and the episode settles the shape as a hard block ("the guardrail will prevent you from doing so").

owned_surfaces.rule: src/trading-window.js (trading-window-v1): unset/inside/outside/unavailable, half-open [start,end) on the trader's own local clock, strict HH:MM, explicit IANA zone, midnight wrap on purpose
owned_surfaces.storage: accounts.window_start / window_end / window_timezone / window_source — four additive nullable columns with the schema's own CHECKs, declared identically on a fresh table and in the migration
owned_surfaces.suggestion: performance.windowSuggestion() + GET /api/bots/window: the best recorded by_session bucket and the circular middle-50 % band of the trader's own recorded entry hours, labelled from_session_history, refused below the 30-trade floor, applied:false always
owned_surfaces.enforcement: correction.dailyState merges the window into the personal state in the state gate's own shape; setup.js carries it as a veto with filters.trading_window; Guards.applyToSetups and the entry-admission path refuse through code that already existed
owned_surfaces.ownership: PUT /api/bots/window — the trader is always the author; from_session_history only when the submitted pair is exactly the current candidate; an explicit clear writes four NULLs
owned_surfaces.surface: public/js/views/settings.js window dialog + public/js/views/bots.js window line

framing_rules: unset blocks nothing and is never mapped onto outside
unavailable refuses and is never mapped onto inside; the repair action is named
the derived suggestion is a description of the trader's own journal, labelled as such, and never applied by the app
a hard boundary does not move when another setting does (a zone change yields unavailable naming both clocks)
the window is a veto beside the non-negotiables — never a scored penalty, never a grade, never an override
no 70 %/causal/predictive/broker/human/mental-state/provider/production claim; nothing retuned; unknown/legacy/imported inputs stay explicitly separate

cohort_before_control_arms.note: Written before the delivered tree's final runs; the builder asserts the measured numbers from analysis/evidence/m112/feature-summary.json and each probe's own results file, so this file is the scope statement, not the evidence.
